result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures), including a new test that reproduces your Anna/Bob example and shows Anna 2, Bob 1.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (`countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep`, around line 6518): the purchase order subquery gets `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarter and latest-PO reports use. Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, sorted as before.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: added `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders`. I also gave the `purchaseOrder` test helper a status parameter, with the existing two-argument version delegating to it.

I did not commit. I did not run the new test against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there.
